turns.q: Where can I find your full shipping policy?
turns.replyTail:
w:

Shipping timeframes start after your order has been shipped and do not include processing time.
Business days exclude weekends and holidays.
Once an order is scanned by the carrier, it is the customer's responsibility to track it.
We offer Package Protection for added peace of mind.
If you need to edit your shipping address, you have a 30-minute window to do so via our Edit Order Dashboard.

Should you need any further assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out.

turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail:
note:

Customers are responsible for paying all taxes and duties in addition to the purchase price of the goods.
International customers may also receive notifications from shipping carriers (such as Passport Global) regarding mandatory customs fees or taxes that must be paid to release the shipment.
As we are based in Canada, your credit card issuer may also charge a small foreign transaction fee (typically 1-3%). This is not a fee from us and does not go to our funds.

Evry Customer Specialist
